question: 咱们库里现在一共收了多少本书啊？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book
note: 单表计数，dim_book 一行一本，直接 COUNT(*)

question: 这些书大概涉及多少位作者？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) AS 作者数 FROM dim_book
note: 按书目去重作者是 184 位；作者档案表有 197 位，差 13 位是名下无书的作者

question: 人民文学出版社出的书咱们收了多少本？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE publisher = '人民文学出版社'
note: 出版社是自由文本，先精确匹配再计数；模糊匹配要用 LIKE

question: 平台上到底有多少人在打分？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 打分用户数 FROM fact_rating
note: 必须 DISTINCT，4202 条评分只来自 101 位用户

question: 现在库里一共攒了多少条评分？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 评分条数 FROM fact_rating
note: 一行一条评分记录，注意和 dim_book.rating_count 求和一致

question: 收藏这个动作一共发生了多少次？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 收藏次数 FROM fact_shelf
note: 收藏=加入书架，三种状态都算；只算想读要加 status='want'

question: 有多少本书是被人加进书架、标记成在读的？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 在读记录数 FROM fact_shelf WHERE status = 'reading'
note: status 取值是 want/reading/read，不是 wish

question: 评论区一共攒了多少条评论？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 评论条数 FROM fact_comment
note: 评论条数不等于评论人数，1976 条只来自 99 人

question: 站内打分的人次加起来有多少？平均每本书有多少人打分？
sql: SELECT SUM(rating_count) AS 评分总人次, ROUND(AVG(rating_count), 2) AS 书均评分人数 FROM dim_book
note: 两个口径一起给：总量用 SUM，书均用 AVG；rating_count 是每本书的评分人数；书均是连续量，按输出约定保留 2 位小数

question: 咱们的书覆盖了几个大类，又涉及多少家出版社？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS 分类数, COUNT(DISTINCT publisher) AS 出版社数 FROM dim_book
note: 分类 12 个；出版社字符串未归一化，69 个里含合并写法

question: 哪个分类的书最多？给我前五名
sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5
note: 分组计数后排序取前五，文学小说 139 本断层第一

question: 哪几家出版社出的书最多？列前十家
sql: SELECT publisher AS 出版社, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY publisher ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, publisher LIMIT 10
note: 出版社有 69 个取值、长尾很重；第二排序键保证同数时结果稳定

question: 各个分类的书都卖多少钱？按平均定价从高到低排
sql: SELECT category AS 分类, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS 平均定价, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE price > 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC
note: price 有 0.2 元这类脏值和 NULL，先 WHERE price > 1 再求均值

question: 哪几年出的书最多？我想看排前面的八年
sql: SELECT pub_year AS 出版年份, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE pub_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pub_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 8
note: 按出版年份分组排序；注意年份跨度 1962-2024，中间大量空年

question: 各个分类的站内评分分别是什么水平？从高到低给我看
sql: SELECT category AS 分类, ROUND(AVG(rating_avg), 2) AS 站内平均评分, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(rating_avg) DESC
note: 用 dimension 表的 rating_avg，书等权；小分类只有 1-5 本，均值不稳

question: 豆瓣评分最高的十本书是哪些？
sql: SELECT title AS 书名, douban_rating AS 豆瓣评分 FROM dim_book ORDER BY douban_rating DESC, title LIMIT 10
note: 豆瓣分与站内分不同源；并列很多，加 title 做第二排序键

question: 平装和精装哪个多？各种装帧分别多少本？
sql: SELECT binding AS 装帧, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY binding ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
note: binding 取值不干净，会出现软精装/精装16开/空串，结果有 8 行

question: 大家把书加进书架的时候，想读、在读、读完分别有多少？
sql: SELECT status AS 收藏状态, COUNT(*) AS 记录数, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 用户数 FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
note: status 三值 want/reading/read，读完最多；用户数要 DISTINCT

question: 最厚的十本书是哪些？
sql: SELECT title AS 书名, pages AS 页数 FROM dim_book ORDER BY pages DESC LIMIT 10
note: 按页数排序取前十；pages 无空值

question: 每个分类的书平均有多厚？
sql: SELECT category AS 分类, ROUND(AVG(pages), 0) AS 平均页数, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(pages) DESC
note: 分组求均值；页数是整数，ROUND 到 0 位便于阅读

question: 评论最多的十本书是哪几本？我想看书名
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS 评论数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_comment c ON c.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(c.comment_id) DESC LIMIT 10
note: JOIN 后按书分组计数；GROUP BY 带上 title 才能 SELECT 书名

question: 被收藏最多的书是哪十本？
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(s.shelf_id) AS 收藏数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_shelf s ON s.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(s.shelf_id) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 收藏表一行一次收藏，COUNT(shelf_id) 即收藏次数

question: 哪几本书又有人点、又有人收藏？给我看综合最热的前十
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, k.click_cnt AS 点击数, s.shelf_cnt AS 收藏数 FROM dim_book b JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS click_cnt FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY book_id) k ON k.book_id = b.book_id JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS shelf_cnt FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY book_id) s ON s.book_id = b.book_id ORDER BY (k.click_cnt + s.shelf_cnt) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 两张事实表先各自按 book_id 预聚合再 JOIN，避免 1:N x 1:N 放大

question: 每个分类总共被点了多少次？
sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(k.click_id) AS 点击数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id AND k.event = 'click' GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY COUNT(k.click_id) DESC
note: event 过滤条件写在 JOIN ON 里等价于 WHERE；只算 click 不含 expose

question: 有哪些书收藏的人比评论的人还多？
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, x.shelf_cnt AS 收藏数, y.comment_cnt AS 评论数 FROM (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS shelf_cnt FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY book_id) x JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_cnt FROM fact_comment GROUP BY book_id) y ON y.book_id = x.book_id JOIN dim_book b ON b.book_id = x.book_id WHERE x.shelf_cnt > y.comment_cnt ORDER BY (x.shelf_cnt - y.comment_cnt) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 两表都先预聚合再比较，HAVING/WHERE 放在 JOIN 之后都可以

question: 各家出版社的书平均被点开多少次？书太少的社先别算
sql: SELECT b.publisher AS 出版社, COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id) AS 书籍数, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(k.click_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id), 1) AS 书均点击数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id AND k.event = 'click' GROUP BY b.publisher HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id) >= 5 ORDER BY ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(k.click_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id), 1) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 书均点击 = 点击数/书数，HAVING 过滤掉少于 5 本的社，避免 1 本书的社排第一

question: 既打过分又写过评论的用户有多少人？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 双重活跃用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM fact_rating INTERSECT SELECT user_id FROM fact_comment) t
note: 用 INTERSECT 求交集去重；评分 101 人、评论 99 人，交集 99 人

question: 每本书的曝光和点击分别是多少？先看点击最多的十本
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, SUM(CASE WHEN f.event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 曝光次数, SUM(CASE WHEN f.event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 点击次数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click f ON f.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN f.event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 同一张事实表用条件聚合做行列转换，不要 JOIN 两次

question: 哪些作者的书被讨论得最多？给我前十位
sql: SELECT b.author_name AS 作者, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS 评论数, COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_comment c ON c.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.author_name ORDER BY COUNT(c.comment_id) DESC LIMIT 10
note: author_name 已冗余在 dim_book，不必 JOIN dim_author；2 本无 author_id 的书仍有作者名
question_v1: 哪位作者的书被讨论得最多？

question: 哪些书评分挺高、但评论区里骂声不少？
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, b.rating_avg AS 站内评分, ROUND(AVG(c.sentiment), 3) AS 评论情感, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS 评论数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_comment c ON c.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.rating_avg >= 8.5 GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title HAVING AVG(c.sentiment) < 0.6 ORDER BY AVG(c.sentiment) ASC LIMIT 10
note: 先 WHERE 过滤高分书，再 HAVING 过滤情感低的；0.6 是相对全量均值 0.845 定的经验阈值，回答时要说明

question: 这两天的点击量按天看是怎么变化的？
sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 点击数 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
note: fact_click 只有 2026-10-18 和 2026-11-01 两天，且都是周日；注意只算 event='click'

question: 曝光和点击每天各有多少？
sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, event AS 事件类型, COUNT(*) AS 次数 FROM fact_click GROUP BY clicked_on, event ORDER BY clicked_on, event
note: 按天和事件类型双维度分组，得到 4 行；这是曝光点击率的数据底座

question: 10月18号到10月31号之间一共点了多少次？涉及多少本书？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 点击数, COUNT(DISTINCT book_id) AS 涉及书籍数 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' AND clicked_on BETWEEN '2026-10-18' AND '2026-10-31'
note: 日期是 TEXT(YYYY-MM-DD)，BETWEEN 字典序等价于时间序；该区间只有 10-18 一天有数据

question: 11月1号那天哪几本书被点得最多？
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(k.click_id) AS 点击数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id WHERE k.event = 'click' AND k.clicked_on = '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(k.click_id) DESC LIMIT 5
note: 单日切片，日期用等号；11-01 有 4826 条事件，是两天的第二天

question: 每天有多少人来逛？
sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 活跃用户数 FROM fact_click GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
note: 人数必须 DISTINCT；曝光和点击都算来访，不去重会变成 4000 多行

question: 按周看点击量是什么样？
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%W', clicked_on) AS 周, COUNT(*) AS 点击数 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%W', clicked_on) ORDER BY 周
note: SQLite 用 STRFTIME('%Y-%W') 取周；只有两周数据，只能看两周对比

question: 每天的点击累计到当天一共多少？我想看累计曲线
sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 当日点击, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY clicked_on) AS 累计点击 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
note: 窗口函数叠加在聚合之上：SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY ...)

question: 10月18号那天加进书架的书，现在都是什么状态？
sql: SELECT status AS 收藏状态, COUNT(*) AS 记录数 FROM fact_shelf WHERE created_on = '2026-10-18' GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
note: 收藏表只有 2026-10-18 一天数据；created_on 与 updated_on 同一天

question: 每天平均每个人点几次？
sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 2) AS 人均点击次数 FROM fact_click GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
note: 分子是点击数，分母是当天出现在点击表里的去重用户（含只曝光的人），口径要在 note 里说明

question: 每本书最后一次被点是什么时候？给我最近活跃的十本
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, MAX(k.clicked_on) AS 最后点击日, COUNT(k.click_id) AS 点击次数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id WHERE k.event = 'click' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY MAX(k.clicked_at) DESC LIMIT 10
note: MAX(clicked_on) 取日期，MAX(clicked_at) 取到时分秒；排序用时间戳更精确

question: 各分类的好评率大概多少？
sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 评分数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 好评率 FROM fact_rating r JOIN dim_book b ON b.book_id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) DESC
note: score 是 0-10 分，好评阈值取 8（等价 4 星）；按评分条数加权，不是按书等权

question: 整体好评率是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 整体好评率 FROM fact_rating
note: 全站口径 73.39%；写成 score>=4 会得到 99.7% 的假值

question: 各分类的书在全部书里占多大比例？
sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_book), 2) AS 占比 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
note: 分母用标量子查询固定为 250，不能用 WHERE 过滤后的行数

question: 曝光转点击的转化率有多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 点击数, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 曝光数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 曝光点击率 FROM fact_click
note: 同一张表条件聚合，一次扫描出三个数；分母必须是 expose 而非总行数

question: 哪几家出版社的好评率最高？只看看书多的社
sql: SELECT b.publisher AS 出版社, COUNT(*) AS 评分数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 好评率 FROM fact_rating r JOIN dim_book b ON b.book_id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.publisher HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) DESC LIMIT 10
note: HAVING COUNT(*)>=100 保证样本量；不加门槛的话 1 本书的社也能 100% 好评

question: 哪些书大家看完愿意写评论？评论和评分的比例高不高？
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, c.comment_cnt AS 评论数, r.rating_cnt AS 评分数, ROUND(1.0 * c.comment_cnt / r.rating_cnt, 2) AS 评论评分比 FROM dim_book b JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_cnt FROM fact_comment GROUP BY book_id) c ON c.book_id = b.book_id JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_cnt FROM fact_rating GROUP BY book_id) r ON r.book_id = b.book_id ORDER BY ROUND(1.0 * c.comment_cnt / r.rating_cnt, 2) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 两个比率要各自预聚合，直接 JOIN 明细会让分子分母同时放大

question: 精装书占多少比例？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN binding = '精装' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 精装数, COUNT(*) AS 总数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN binding = '精装' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 精装占比 FROM dim_book
note: binding 有软精装/精装16开等变体，严格等于'精装'只统计到 63 本，口径要说明

question: 评分在8.5分以上的书占多大比例？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rating_avg >= 8.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 高分书数, COUNT(*) AS 总数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rating_avg >= 8.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 高分占比 FROM dim_book
note: 这里是书等权的占比（174/250）；不是评分条数的占比，两者不要混

question: 各分类的收藏转化怎么样？收藏数除以点击数看看
sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shelf_id) AS 收藏数, COUNT(DISTINCT k.click_id) AS 点击数, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT s.shelf_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT k.click_id), 3) AS 收藏点击比 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_shelf s ON s.book_id = b.book_id JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id AND k.event = 'click' GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT s.shelf_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT k.click_id), 3) DESC
note: 两张事实表 JOIN 会放大，用 COUNT(DISTINCT 主键) 抵消；更严谨的是先预聚合

question: 有多少书豆瓣分比咱们站内高？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN douban_rating > rating_avg THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 豆瓣更高的书数, COUNT(*) AS 总数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN douban_rating > rating_avg THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS 占比 FROM dim_book
note: 两个评分不同源，只能比高低，不能相加或求平均；196/250 豆瓣更高

question: 最受欢迎的是哪几本书？给我前五名
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(s.shelf_id) AS 收藏数, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS 收藏人数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_shelf s ON s.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) DESC, COUNT(s.shelf_id) DESC LIMIT 5
note: 口径：'最受欢迎'取加入书架的去重人数——收藏是成本最高的强意向信号，比点击/曝光更抗噪声；不用 dim_book.rating_avg，因为那是质量不是流行度

question: 评分最高的是哪几本书？给我前五名
sql: SELECT title AS 书名, rating_avg AS 站内评分, rating_count AS 评分人数 FROM dim_book WHERE rating_count >= 10 ORDER BY rating_avg DESC, rating_count DESC LIMIT 5
note: 口径：加 rating_count >= 10 的样本门槛再排 rating_avg，避免小样本高分；本数据每本至少 6 人评分，门槛放 10 后第一名是《少年凯歌》9.7/17 人

question: 最贵的几本书是哪几本？给我前五本，顺便说说值不值这个价
sql: SELECT title AS 书名, price AS 定价, pages AS 页数, ROUND(price / NULLIF(pages, 0), 2) AS 每页价格 FROM dim_book WHERE price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5
note: 口径：绝对定价排第一是 498 元的《哈利·波特》多卷套装，属正常现象；判断'值不值'要换算成每页价格，price 里的 0.2 元脏值不会进降序前五，但算均价时必须先 WHERE price > 1
question_v1: 最贵的书是哪本？值不值这个价？

question: 哪些分类的口碑最好？给我前五名
sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数, ROUND(AVG(rating_avg), 2) AS 简单平均, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(rating_avg * rating_count) / SUM(rating_count), 2) AS 加权平均 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY ROUND(1.0 * SUM(rating_avg * rating_count) / SUM(rating_count), 2) DESC LIMIT 5
note: 口径：用评分人数加权，让'被打分多的书'说话；简单平均会让只有 1-5 本的小分类靠单本高分冲榜。两种口径的第一名都是哲学宗教，但小分类名次会变

question: 大家最爱讨论哪些分类？给我前五名
sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS 评论数, COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id) AS 书籍数, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(c.comment_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id), 1) AS 书均评论数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_comment c ON c.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY COUNT(c.comment_id) DESC LIMIT 5
note: 口径：'最爱讨论'看总评论数，但总评论数会被分类规模带偏（文学小说 139 本），所以同时给出书均评论数做校正

question: 哪几本书争议最大？给我前五本
sql: SELECT title AS 书名, rating_avg AS 站内评分, sentiment_score AS 评论情感, positive_rate AS 正向评论占比, rating_count AS 评分人数 FROM dim_book WHERE rating_count >= 10 ORDER BY (rating_avg / 10.0 - sentiment_score) DESC, rating_count DESC LIMIT 5
note: 口径：'争议'=评分高但评论情感低，用 rating_avg/10 与 sentiment 同尺度后作差；不用方差（评论只有一条也能算出极值）

question: 有没有那种叫好不叫座的书？就是评分挺高、但收藏和点击都很少的
sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, b.category AS 分类, b.rating_avg AS 站内评分, k.click_cnt AS 曝光加点击次数, s.shelf_cnt AS 收藏数 FROM dim_book b JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS click_cnt FROM fact_click GROUP BY book_id) k ON k.book_id = b.book_id JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS shelf_cnt FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY book_id) s ON s.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.rating_avg >= 8.5 AND k.click_cnt < 20 ORDER BY b.rating_avg DESC LIMIT 10
note: 口径：高评分低曝光 = rating_avg>=8.5 且 click_cnt<20（click_cnt 含曝光事件）；阈值是约定，回答时要写出来，全库符合条件 25 本

question: 哪些出版社的书最受欢迎？给我前十名
sql: SELECT b.publisher AS 出版社, COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id) AS 书籍数, COUNT(s.shelf_id) AS 收藏数, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(s.shelf_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id), 1) AS 书均收藏数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_shelf s ON s.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.publisher HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id) >= 5 ORDER BY ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(s.shelf_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.book_id), 1) DESC LIMIT 10
note: 口径：用书均收藏数而不是总收藏数，否则出版社规模决定排名；HAVING>=5 本过滤长尾小社

question: 评分人数最多的书说明了什么？
sql: SELECT title AS 书名, rating_count AS 评分人数, rating_avg AS 站内评分, douban_votes AS 豆瓣评价人数 FROM dim_book ORDER BY rating_count DESC LIMIT 10
note: 口径：'评分人数最多'直接取 dim_book.rating_count（站内人数），不要拿 douban_votes 比——豆瓣人数是十万级，量级完全不同

question: 平台最近是不是热闹起来了？
sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 点击数, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 曝光数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 曝光点击率 FROM fact_click GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
note: 口径：'热闹'看 click 与 expose 两个量以及曝光点击率，不看总行数（总行数把曝光混进来）；只有两天数据，只能说 11-01 相对 10-18 的变化，不能外推趋势
